aavtaar.label: Aavtaar
aavtaar.campaignHelp: The campaign that defines the AI script/persona for outbound calls. Provided by your AI-calling provider.

vacademyAi.label: Vacademy AI Agent
vacademyAi.companyCodePlaceholder: Not needed — calls run on your Vacademy Voice number
vacademyAi.campaignPlaceholder: Pick an agent from the AI Agents section below
vacademyAi.campaignHelp: Vacademy AI agents are authored in the "AI Agents" section below — saving one registers it here automatically (its id is the campaign id).

fallback.campaignHelp: The campaign or agent that defines the AI script for outbound calls.

toast.settingsSaveFailed: Failed to save AI calling settings
toast.campaignIdRequired: A default Campaign ID is required to enable AI calling.

enableCard.title: AI Calling
enableCard.description: When enabled, leads are first called by the AI voice agent. The recording and AI summary appear on the lead profile, and a counsellor is assigned only when the outcome rules below say so.
enableCard.showInLeadList: Show the AI-call button on lead rows
enableCard.showInLeadListHint: Controls only the manual robot button in lead lists. Automated AI workflows run regardless of this toggle.
enableCard.inboundLeadCaptureHint: For an inbound AI helpline: when someone calls and isn't already a lead, a lead is created (matched by phone, so repeat callers aren't duplicated) and the call attaches to it — so it shows in Recent Leads and the Call Log, and you can follow up. Off means unknown callers' calls are recorded but no lead is made.
enableCard.providerHint: The AI calling agent used for this institute. The credentials and campaign below are for the selected provider.

campaigns.title: Campaigns / Agents

description.part1: Register each AI campaign id and give it an agent
description.part3: , not the raw id — pick the same name once per provider and switching provider resolves to the right id automatically. Tag each Outbound (you dial) or Inbound (they dial your AI line); Inbound ids classify incoming webhooks (matched to the lead by phone).

campaigns.empty: No campaigns registered yet. Add one and tag it Inbound to enable inbound-call detection.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: API credentials for this institute's AI calling provider. The token and webhook secret are stored encrypted and never shown again.
credentials.webhookHelp: Authenticates the provider's end-of-call webhook. Hand your AI provider the URL {{webhookPath}}?instituteId=…&token=<this secret>.

retryCard.title: Retries & Calling Shifts
retryCard.description: If a lead doesn't answer, the AI retries within these limits before giving up. Retries are only placed inside the shifts below.
retryCard.retryGapHint: How long the bot waits before re-dialing a no-answer lead.
retryCard.callingShiftsHint: Time windows the bot may (re)dial in. Add multiple shifts (e.g. morning + evening). Applies to the timed retry re-dialer; immediate new-lead, manual and bulk calls fire right away.
retryCard.connectThresholdHint: Shorter calls count as “not connected” and are retried.

outcomeAction.title: Outcome → Action
outcomeAction.description: For each AI-call outcome, choose what happens. Outcomes left off both lists are retried until max retries, then assigned to a human. Add custom outcomes below for the dispositions your own AI agent returns.
outcomeAction.addOutcomePlaceholder: Add a custom outcome (e.g. Wrong Number)
outcomeAction.otherwiseRetry: Retry, then assign after max retries

assignmentCard.title: Counsellor Assignment
assignmentCard.description: How a counsellor is picked when a lead qualifies (or when retries are exhausted).
assignmentCard.assignExhausted: Assign no-answer leads to a human after retries are exhausted
assignmentCard.reassignQualified: Give qualified leads to this list's pool, even if they already have a counsellor
assignmentCard.reassignQualifiedHint: Use for lists of previously-worked leads: when the AI books or qualifies one, it goes to the pool instead of staying with whoever last held it. Leads that simply never answered are never moved.

carrierStrip.notReadyFallback: AI calls can't be placed yet.

apiCard.title: API & webhooks
apiCard.description: Let your CRM, website or automation tool start AI calls and receive each call's result. Your server sends a key with every request; we post the outcome to your webhook when the call ends.
apiCard.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Keep keys on your server. Never put one in a web page or a mobile app.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeDescription: Requests that use "{{name}}" stop working straight away. Calls already queued still go ahead.
keys.formHint: Leave the expiry empty for a key that does not expire.
keys.issuedWarning: This is the only time the key is shown. Copy it and store it on your server.
keys.issuedUsage: Start a call from your server:

errors.generic: Check the form and try again.

keys.notCopiedWarning: You have not copied the key. Close again to discard it; it cannot be shown again.
keys.humanCallsHint: Lets this key list your counsellors' names and emails and connect them to contacts by phone (human_calls:read, human_calls:write). Keys cannot be changed later.
keys.manageCounsellorsHint: Lets this key add counsellors (each gets a dashboard login and a welcome email), change their name, mobile number and Airtel extension, and deactivate them (counsellors:manage). It never touches admins or other staff. Keys cannot be changed later.
keys.manageAgentsHint: Lets this key create, edit, turn on or off and delete AI agents, choose the default agent and which agent answers an inbound number (agents:manage). Keys cannot be changed later.

agents.title: Agent ids
agents.description: Send one of these as agent_id to choose which AI agent makes the call.
agents.empty: No outbound agents yet. Create one above.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: When a call ends we send call.completed or call.not_connected to this HTTPS address, signed with your webhook secret. Failed deliveries are retried for about 9 hours.
webhook.urlRequired: Enter the address of your endpoint.
webhook.testFailed: The test event was not accepted: {{reason}}
webhook.testError: Could not send the test event.
webhook.rotateFailed: Could not create a new secret.
webhook.removeDescription: Call results are no longer sent to your endpoint. Your server can still fetch them with GET /v1/calls/{id}.
webhook.secretWarning: This is the only time the secret is shown. Your server uses it to check the Telleo-Signature header on every delivery.
webhook.rotateDescription: Every delivery from now on is signed with the new secret. Until your server uses it, its signature checks will fail and events will be retried. Update your server right after copying the new secret.

header.title: AI Calling Settings
header.description: AI-first calling: who the AI calls, from which line, how often it retries, and what happens after each outcome.
header.disabledBanner: AI calling is off. Switch it on in the AI calling tab to set up retries, outcomes and assignment.
